title: Smooth tower chart and finite compatibility interfaces
statement: For a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell, retain the ordinary coefficient-tower base, canonical operations and section-normalized coordinates of [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces]. Define level as exact evaluation restricted to the full finite ctf category; support as the actual restriction of the chosen compactification functor. Define coefficientMate as the finite right-adjunction transpose of scalar extension of its counit after the inverse of the specified direct-image coefficient comparison. Levels records finite ctf preservation, finite right adjunctions and their exceptional realizations, the actual support evaluations, counit- and unit-preserving natural right comparisons, scalar preservation and the displayed reduction equation using precisely these coefficient mates. Define the graph quotient rings and transition maps, their section-preserving GraphCoordinates with normalized units, counits and push evaluations; define graphForward, pull, open, sum, derived sum and support comparisons by the stated adjunction-unique and right-derived coordinate transports. EtaleNormalized requires the specified calculus etale-shriek comparison to equal the actual graph theta after these transports. ConstructionAt retains the full normalized coordinate construction at an explicit chart family. openBase bundles the inherited field structure of an open. Charts records a finite coefficient calculus, its etale graph normalization, its actual normalized coordinate adjunction family, the geometric properties of opens, and counit-preserving comparisons with the right-adjoint restrictions on every coordinate chart. These are exactly the existing definitions moved without changing any body, signature, field, attribute or mathematical datum; no existence is asserted.
